surface_name: Messages API, computer use tool on Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
title: computer_20251124 returns 400 on Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
symptoms: 400 error when a request declares computer_20251124 with claude-fable-5-2 or claude-mythos-5-2
cause: These models support computer use only through the computer_toolset_20260801 toolset. The older tool still works only on Amazon Bedrock.
fix: Replace the computer_20251124 tool declaration with computer_toolset_20260801 on the Claude API and Google Cloud, and update any tool-result handling to match the migration guide.
affected: claude-fable-5-2 and claude-mythos-5-2 on every platform except Amazon Bedrock, from November 9, 2026
